# Source: compose.yml

**The container on the shared fridge-next runtime.** Explained in [build deploy](../build-deploy.md). [On GitHub](https://github.com/LuckyMonkey/luckymonkey/blob/main/compose.yml) (needs repo access). Generated by `tools/wiki-source.py`; back to the [source index](index.md).

```yaml
# Lucky Monkey - its own container on the shared fridge-next runtime.
#   sudo fridge-next luckymonkey up | down | restart | build | logs
services:
  luckymonkey:
    image: fridge-next:14
    container_name: luckymonkey
    working_dir: /opt/fridge-next/apps/luckymonkey
    command: ["next", "start", "-p", "3000"]
    user: node
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    tmpfs: [/tmp]
    volumes:
      - ./:/opt/fridge-next/apps/luckymonkey:ro
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      HOSTNAME: 0.0.0.0
    mem_limit: 256m
    networks: [web]
networks:
  web:
    name: fridge-homepage_default
    external: true
```
